observations.result: No grant omits commands. library:read discovers 16 disabled commands without execute or checked values. library:write enables navigation but cannot change shelf fields. Fully granted Worker sees authorized checked values and can execute.
Two synthetic FB2 books selected in their collection remained selected after layout-list returned completed [settings, workspace]. Collection ID and both selected IDs were unchanged.
Global Agent go-stats and book Agent go-context returned completed [workspace]. Book-scope discovery returned all 16 commands. Reusing revision 4 after subsequent navigation rejected ui/superseded.

Opening a real synthetic FB2 disabled go-stats for library:write-only Worker with reader-control reason. Executing rejected ui/unavailable. open-settings completed while workspace.surface remained reader; full Worker then closed reading and completed statistics.

A BEFORE UPDATE trigger on only read-aware-shelf-view rejected both Worker and Agent layout-grid with db/error. Workspace remained statistics at revision 12 and persisted layout-list remained checked. Removing the trigger let the Agent complete layout-grid.

Library Desk 0.4 Workspace > Host commands rendered the host catalog. Actual search input list view filtered to Switch to list view; clicking it saved shelf.layout=list, returned to shelf and closed the dialog. 1200x800 command UI and 800x650 list-layout result screenshots were inspected; no document horizontal overflow.

compiledFailureRecovery: A second exact shelf-key SQL trigger kept the compiled command dialog open after grid-view click. The later screenshot shows the correctly filtered row and no raw SQL; it does not prove an earlier transient toast was visible. Removing the trigger and clicking again saved grid and closed the dialog.
boundaries: Direct deterministic Agent tool execution is not autonomous model behavior.
Deferred storage, all 16 mappings, retirement and post-write partial receipts are covered by unit tests, not a full native concurrency or crash-recovery campaign.
Native command palette still has its own callback dispatch. Dynamic book/collection items, import tasks and cross-plugin invocation remain open; UI03 stays partial.
Discovery reports coarse authorization/workspace conditions, not a reservation or proof that the selection target still exists.
The plugin command page is a refreshable snapshot, not an observer. Installation/upgrade consent, packaged builds, Windows/Linux and complete focus behavior are unverified.
developmentRecovery: Initial workspace preview used stale Library Desk 0.3 compiled output, whose Workspace page correctly lacked Host commands. No plugin-composition success was claimed for it. Its owned books/workers were cleaned up, the 0.4 plugin was explicitly built, and a fresh preview exercised the actual command page.

A guessed optimized window-module import failed. Window resize used the MCP window API instead. First capture preceded native repaint and was not accepted as UI evidence; subsequent screenshots showed the dialog and actual result. The 800 search screenshot shows pre-filter rows, so search filtering is supported by DOM and successful click evidence, not that image.
Existing bridge-version, native compile warnings and an initial WebView process termination/reboot are not claimed fixed.
